The easiest way to create personal cloud storage would be to buy your own server.

Then there's the option of purchasing a modem/router with USB expansion, and set it up for cloud storage.

Then, there's setting up a Raspberry Pi on your network, and tying it to an external HD. This will give you a Linux interface which you can tap into via SSH and FTP and store your files. You can also set up a mail server here to cover that option.

The beauty about setting up a Pi (or personal computer) on your network is that you can run whatever OS you want: Arch, Ubuntu, RedHat, etc. You're not just limited to ArkOS, and you can tailor it to the way you want it to work.
